mainPrograms.title: Main Programs
mainPrograms.description: Explore the main programs at {appName}, including exhibitions, business conferences, seminars, and business matching. Gain insights and network with industry experts.

0.title: Exhibition
0.description: Featuring Indonesia's top ceramic manufacturers with their latest products and designs, alongside essential industry needs, from raw materials and machinery to cutting-edge technology and equipment.

1.title: Opening Ceremony
1.description: Join the grand opening alongside the 23rd Megabuild Indonesia, inaugurated by the Ministry of Industry and attended by distinguished guests from institutions, associations, communities, and media.

2.title: Keramika Conference
2.description: Dive into relevant ceramic industry topics for the second half of 2026. Featuring expert speakers and industry leaders, this conference runs on the first and second days of the exhibition.

3.title: 1O1 - Business Matching
3.description: Connecting Indonesian ceramic manufacturers with ASEAN importers, new distributors, and project owners. We also link suppliers of raw materials, technology, and machinery with manufacturers across the region.

4.title: Power Networking Night
4.description: An evening dinner and networking session for company owners, top management, association leaders, and all industry stakeholders. Build connections that lead to meaningful collaborations for the future.

5.title: Hosted Buyer Program
5.description: We're bringing in targeted buyers and partners from across the ASEAN region to connect with exhibitors. Accommodation fully covered by the organizer for qualified industry players.

6.title: The Beauty of Indonesia Ceramics Installation
6.description: A curated showcase highlighting the finest designs from Indonesian ceramics, from floor tiles and sanitaryware to roofing products and tableware. See the best of local craftsmanship in one place.

7.title: Professional & Student Visit
7.description: Inviting architects, interior designers, consultants, design students, and lecturers from Singapore, Malaysia, and Indonesia to explore the exhibition and discover the latest in ceramic innovation.

8.title: Brand Talks
8.description: Podcast-style sessions discussing the latest products, designs, technologies, and innovations from participating brands. Each brand gets a dedicated 30-minute spotlight to share their story.

9.title: Ceramics Artistic Showcase
9.description: Watch ceramics artists demonstrate traditional and modern pottery-making techniques using local clay. Live demos feature various tools and materials, inspiring visitors to try their hand at the craft.

10.title: Designer Workshops
10.description: Partnering with Ikatan Arsitek Indonesia and Himpunan Interior Desainer Indonesia to deliver workshops, training, and educational programs that add real value for their members attending the exhibition.

11.title: Building Contractors & Property Developers Members Gathering
11.description: A collaborative event with the Indonesian Real Estate Association and Indonesian Contractors Association, bringing members together for networking and knowledge-sharing during the exhibition.

12.title: Seminars, Forum, Talkshows
12.description: Featuring media partners like Tender Indonesia, Archinesia, and Indonesia Design, these sessions attract the ceramic exhibition's target audience with valuable insights and industry discussions.

13.title: Jakarta Design Week 2026
13.description: In collaboration with Ikatan Arsitek Indonesia and DKI Jakarta Provincial Government, this event brings forums and conferences tackling architectural challenges and innovations shaping the city's future.

14.title: Floor & Wall Tile Installation Competition
14.description: Tile installers compete using products from Keramika exhibitors. Showcase your skills and craftsmanship for a chance to win a cash prize of 5 million rupiah.

15.title: Keramika Charity
15.description: Exhibitors donate specially selected products to be sold to visitors, with all proceeds going directly to charitable foundations. Shop for great products while supporting a good cause.

16.title: Keramika Awards 2026
16.description: Recognizing excellence in Indonesia's ceramic industry. In partnership with HDII, IAI, and GBCI, we honor outstanding achievements in categories like Best Design, Best Finishes, Color, and more.

17.title: Keramika Best Booth
17.description: Celebrating booth creativity across four categories: large booths (>108 sqm), medium booths (50-108 sqm), small booths (<50 sqm), and the Favorite Booth chosen by popular vote.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about our event, tickets, exhibitors, and more.
faq.emptyState: We are gathering commonly asked questions. Please come back later.
faq.contactTitle: Have any questions? Just send it to us!

0.q: When and where will {eventTitle} take place?
0.a: {eventTitle} will be held on {eventDate}, from {eventTime}, at {eventLocation}.

1.q: How do I get tickets to attend the event?
1.a: You can get your tickets through our official website. Simply click the Get Ticket button and follow the registration process. E-tickets will be sent to your email and WhatsApp after purchase.

2.q: How much does a ticket cost?
2.a: Ticket prices vary depending on the ticket type and promotional period. Please visit our Ticket page for the most up-to-date pricing information. Don't miss our early bird and pre-sale promotions for special discounts!

3.q: Can I get a refund if I can't attend?
3.a: All ticket sales are final. There are no refunds or exchanges once a ticket has been purchased. Please review our Ticket Refund and Return Policy for more details.

4.q: What should I bring to the event?
4.a: Please bring your e-ticket (digital or printed) to be exchanged for a badge or wristband at the registration counter. We also recommend bringing business cards if you plan to network with exhibitors and other attendees.

5.a: The event is open to the public. Whether you're an architect, interior designer, contractor, property developer, or simply interested in ceramic products and home renovation, you're welcome to attend!

6.q: What brands will be exhibiting at the event?
6.a: We feature a diverse range of brands from the ceramics and building materials industry. You can view the list of exhibitors on our Brands page. The list will be updated as we get closer to the event date.

7.q: How can I become an exhibitor?
7.a: To become an exhibitor, please visit our Exhibitor Registration page or contact our team via WhatsApp for more information about booth packages and availability.

8.q: Are there any seminars or workshops at the event?
8.a: Yes! We organize various conferences, seminars, workshops, and networking sessions. Check our Rundown page for the complete schedule of activities and speaker sessions.

9.q: How can I become a sponsor or media partner?
9.a: We welcome sponsorship and media partnership opportunities. Please contact us via WhatsApp or {email} to discuss partnership packages.

10.q: Is there parking available at the venue?
10.a: Yes, the venue provides parking facilities. However, we recommend arriving early as parking spaces may fill up quickly during peak hours. You may also consider using public transportation or ride-sharing services.

11.q: Can I take photos or videos at the event?
11.a: Personal photography and video recording for non-commercial purposes are allowed. However, professional or commercial recording requires written permission from the organizer. Please refer to our Event Policy for more details.

12.q: What are the rules I need to follow at the event?
12.a: All attendees must comply with our event rules and regulations, including following instructions from event staff and security personnel. Please read our Event Policy before attending.

13.q: How can I stay updated about the event?
13.a: Follow us on Instagram {'@'}{instagram} for the latest updates, announcements, and exclusive content. You can also check our News page for articles and updates.

14.q: How do I contact the organizer?
14.a:
You can reach us through:

  • WhatsApp: Click here to chat
  • Email: {email}

Visit our Help Center for more contact options and quick links to useful information.
